verdict.rationale: Bolna offers call-level automation building blocks — auto-generated call summaries, custom extraction categories, and a call-history/analytics tab with performance metrics, transcripts and recordings — that could feed into quality review, but there's no documented feature that explicitly scores call quality, flags failures, or analyzes resolution outcomes automatically. missing for 10: dedicated quality-scoring/QA feature, explicit failure-flagging logic, resolution/outcome classification, and any independent evidence these analytics are used for automated review.
